workspace_audit_events_action_check.name: workspace_audit_events_action_check
workspace_audit_events_action_check.value: ("workspace_audit_events"."action" = 'eligibility_settings_published' AND "workspace_audit_events"."settings_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."previous_settings_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."coupon_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."before_status" IS NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."after_status" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_audit_events"."action" IN ('coupon_created', 'coupon_status_changed') AND "workspace_audit_events"."settings_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."previous_settings_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."coupon_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."after_status" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."after_status" IN ('active','paused','archived') AND (("workspace_audit_events"."action" = 'coupon_created' AND "workspace_audit_events"."before_status" IS NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."after_status" = 'active') OR ("workspace_audit_events"."action" = 'coupon_status_changed' AND "workspace_audit_events"."before_status" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_audit_events"."before_status" IN ('active','paused') AND "workspace_audit_events"."before_status" <> "workspace_audit_events"."after_status")))

workspace_coupons_definition_check.name: workspace_coupons_definition_check
workspace_coupons_definition_check.value: "workspace_coupons"."scope" = 'workspace_membership' AND "workspace_coupons"."code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{2,31}$' AND "workspace_coupons"."status" IN ('active','paused','archived') AND (("workspace_coupons"."discount_type" = 'fixed' AND "workspace_coupons"."discount_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000) OR ("workspace_coupons"."discount_type" = 'percentage' AND "workspace_coupons"."discount_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 9999)) AND ("workspace_coupons"."usage_limit" IS NULL OR "workspace_coupons"."usage_limit" > 0) AND ("workspace_coupons"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_coupons"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_coupons"."starts_at" < "workspace_coupons"."expires_at") AND length("workspace_coupons"."campaign_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length("workspace_coupons"."source_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "workspace_coupons"."source_type" IN ('influencer','partner','institution','founder','organic_campaign','internal','other') AND "workspace_coupons"."version" > 0

workspace_eligibility_attempts_dates_che.name: workspace_eligibility_attempts_dates_check
workspace_eligibility_attempts_dates_che.value: ("workspace_eligibility_attempts"."result" = 'eligible' AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."eligible_until" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."eligible_until" > "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."decided_at" AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."reapply_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_eligibility_attempts"."result" = 'ineligible' AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."reapply_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."reapply_at" > "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."decided_at" AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."eligible_until" IS NULL)

workspace_eligibility_attempts_experienc.name: workspace_eligibility_attempts_experience_check
workspace_eligibility_attempts_experienc.value: "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."experience_months" = CASE "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."experience_option" WHEN 'under_one' THEN 0 WHEN 'one_year' THEN 12 WHEN 'two_years' THEN 24 WHEN 'three_to_five' THEN 36 WHEN 'six_to_ten' THEN 72 WHEN 'eleven_to_fifteen' THEN 132 WHEN 'sixteen_to_twenty' THEN 192 WHEN 'twenty_plus' THEN 240 ELSE -1 END AND "workspace_eligibility_attempts"."experience_months" >= 0

workspace_eligibility_settings_bounds_ch.name: workspace_eligibility_settings_bounds_check
workspace_eligibility_settings_bounds_ch.value: ("workspace_eligibility_settings"."config"->>'minimumExperienceMonths')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 600 AND ("workspace_eligibility_settings"."config"->>'eligibilityValidityDays')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 90 AND ("workspace_eligibility_settings"."config"->>'cooldownDays')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 90 AND "workspace_eligibility_settings"."config"->>'timezone' = 'Asia/Kolkata' AND jsonb_typeof("workspace_eligibility_settings"."config"->'profileRequired') = 'boolean' AND jsonb_array_length("workspace_eligibility_settings"."config"->'allowedCategories') BETWEEN 1 AND 15

workspace_plans_definition_check.name: workspace_plans_definition_check
workspace_plans_definition_check.value: "workspace_membership_plans"."version" > 0 AND length("workspace_membership_plans"."display_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "workspace_membership_plans"."base_price_paise" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000 AND "workspace_membership_plans"."tax_rate_bps" = 1800 AND "workspace_membership_plans"."currency" = 'INR' AND (("workspace_membership_plans"."code" = 'quarterly' AND "workspace_membership_plans"."duration_months" = 3) OR ("workspace_membership_plans"."code" = 'half_yearly' AND "workspace_membership_plans"."duration_months" = 6) OR ("workspace_membership_plans"."code" = 'yearly' AND "workspace_membership_plans"."duration_months" = 12))
